findings.reason: The dated Main-review framing is natural in the title, dek and opening. The article plainly admits the equities/Bitcoin downside map was wrong while retaining the gold-up and USD-down matches. Its takeaway separates election outcome, market direction and horizon; it makes no claim of investing success.

SOURCE_1 and SOURCE_2 remain two projections of the same original Main review, not independent event confirmation. Public facts stay attributed to that review. The scope notice appears once in the canonical body. The expected-outcome passage is a words-only priced-base-case assessment from SOURCE_2 and is explicitly distinguished from proof that anticipation caused market moves.

The exact three retained card sentences remain in the body under What moved when. Gold 05:00-07:00 UTC maps to 12:00-14:00 Bangkok; US500 from 04:00 UTC maps to 11:00 Bangkok; Bitcoin 14:00-15:00 UTC maps to 21:00-22:00 Bangkok; oil 12:00-17:00 UTC maps to 19:00-24:00 Bangkok. Bangkok is explicitly GMT+7. US500 climbing through Asia and Europe, the inferred broker UTC clock basis, and the limit on exact catalyst timing all remain. No later 5 November price observation is introduced.

Timing is not presented as election causality. The priced-base-case interpretation is a competing explanation to examine, not an asserted mechanism. The countercase retains matching legs and makes clear that one mixed case cannot establish a universal mechanism, hit rate or forecasting skill.

The canonical article contains the exact analysis/not-financial-advice, reader-decision and possible-positions disclosures. All eight full derivative payloads retain those notices, with X and Threads using their complete ordered chains.

No numerical prediction-market odds, raw prices/history, percentage returns, account/execution details, alpha or trading-result claims, unsupported dealer/gamma/liquidation/geopolitical explanations, or forbidden preview-host URL appear in the reviewed public prose. The internal SOURCE markers, URN source identities and source_date_notice remain metadata/internal compilation inputs; the derivative text does not expose them or KEEP/PREPARED workflow labels.

Both image byte hashes still match the assets inspected earlier in this same role. The card is source-bound, contains no raw prices, attributes its windows to the review and visibly qualifies the clock inference. The selected Capitol photo retains its 1997 archive caption, full canonical credit, exact public-domain rights receipt and context-only status.

All eight actual payloads preserve the candid correction in their review-led title or text and retain either the serious interpretation limit or the separate-condition/direction/horizon lesson. X and Threads must be assessed as their complete ordered reply chains. No generic unconfirmed fallback or hard-truncated copy replaces the authored lesson.
